name: game-checkpoint-images
goal: Generate and persist one GPT Image reference per checkpoint without changing mechanics or exposing project credentials

steps.title: Confirm scope, success criteria, constraints, and proof.
steps.evidence: Checkpoint-specific prompt and persisted image metadata; explicit one-image GPT Image 2 request; ignored project-owned OpenAI key, header auth; history read-only; no mechanic changes.

steps.title: Implement the smallest complete feature slice.
steps.evidence: GPT Image 2 backend, project credential reader, immutable PNG repository, local IPC, checkpoint direction/image editor and generated-game runtime references implemented. Opus returned HTTP 529 and retry stopped after eight minutes without edits; controls reuse existing styles.

steps.title: Add or update focused automated coverage.
steps.evidence: 17 engine tests, 19 host/credential/transport tests, 23 root integration/impact tests and 11 browser scenarios pass. Both generated dimensions pass standalone check. Root check timing failures pass isolated unchanged retries; live project OpenAI API remains unproven without dedicated key. Root E2E: 232 tests across 70 files pass.

steps.title: Run the relevant project verification commands.
steps.evidence: Code verification passes at affected boundaries. Full root check reported timing-sensitive failures; ten unchanged tests passed in isolation. A live OpenAI project API request remains pending a dedicated game credential; sample art was generated through built-in GPT Image.
